_doc: Program 4 — regime-conditioned consumption (toy family). Identical harness/forward_walk/cost/qualification/universe to research_config_majors.json so toy consumers are measured in Program 1's exact court (intrabar_fixed, 12bps, alpha=0.05). The extra top-level 'regime' block parameterizes the no-lookahead volatility-regime labeler + the conditioning controls; it is hash-neutral to ResearchConfig.sha256 (only the known blocks are hashed). The spine consumer is measured via research_config_spine_majors.json (apply_signal_defaults=false). FROZEN parameters per the pre-registration doc — do NOT grid these after a null (anti-archaeology).
